worldcombat.skill.electroshot.summary: Gather electricity into your body to raise Special Attack, then fire a high-voltage lance that follows the target. In rain the charge comes straight from the weather, so it fires at once: stand and gather in clear weather, or snap it off the moment it rains.
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.use.0: An instant high-voltage shot in the rain
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.use.1: A lance that a walking target cannot shake
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.use.2: Bank a Special Attack stage, then spend it
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.descriptio: The lance deals %1$s special damage where it strikes.

Gathering takes %1$s of standing still (you cannot move, and it can be interrupted; in rain it is skipped and the lance fires at once); on completion Special Attack rises by %2$s stage(s), hit or miss.
The lance flies at %1$s blocks per tick, reaches %2$s blocks and has a %3$s-block hitbox radius; it strikes the first non-ally on its path and scatters at the far end if it hits no one.
The lance steers toward the target with a turn strength of %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.stance.cha: Chase: the lance steers harder and reaches further, so walking cannot shake it, but each hit is lighter, it flies a little slower and the cooldown is 3 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.stance.dir: Direct: it flies faster and hits harder, but barely steers and is easy to sidestep.
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s it consumes %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and cools down for %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.growth.0: From level %1$s the lance power steps up with level.
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.growth.1: From level %1$s the lance power steps up again.
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.growth.2: At level %1$s the cooldown from commit drops to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.electroshot.preference: On (chase): the lance steers harder (x1.6) and reaches further, but each hit is x0.9, it flies a little slower and the cooldown is 3 ticks longer, so walking cannot shake it. Off (direct): it flies faster and hits x1.15 harder, but barely steers and is easy to sidestep.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first instead of firing; higher means it opens fire from further away.
Inside this distance the companion lowers its firing priority so it does not stand gathering within reach; 0 means it fires even point-blank.
On: raises priority while it rains, when the shot fires at once and still grants the Special Attack stage; off: weather is ignored.
